items.title: AMD, Broadcom stocks sink on tighter US chip rules, CoreWeave and Nebius shares drop
items.summary: Chip and AI infrastructure stocks moved lower as the US moved to restrict semiconductor exports to China in the wake of Nvidia's CEO scandal.

items.title: Nvidia’s Bull Case: AI Labs Must “Quadruple Their R&D Compute” Yearly per Dwarkesh Patel
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDwarkesh Patel says AI labs must quadruple R&D compute yearly just to keep the same pace of progress. That ties chip demand to the race itself, favoring NVIDIA, Broadcom and TSMC while the spending lasts.

items.title: Jensen Huang Reportedly Considers Returning To Nvidia: FT
items.summary: Jensen Huang reportedly is mulling a return to the chip giant he founded, days after resigning as Nvidia CEO in scandal. Nvidia stock was indicated little changed.

items.title: U.S. chip stocks slide as traders unwind Nvidia rival bets before earnings
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. chip stocks are down sharply on Monday as traders took profits on recent gains in Nvidia’s rivals ahead of the AI giant’s earnings, while worries about tighter export controls added to the pressure.

items.title: Broadcom’s Quiet 8% November Move Could Ramp Up Very Quickly in This Volatile Climate and I’m Buying
items.summary: While the VIX whipsawed and investors fled quality names, one chipmaker kept drawing fresh money from a retirement-minded buyer. Why does he pass on NVIDIA and AMD, and what risk does he admit could still bite?

items.title: Chip stocks fall on US semiconductor restrictions: AlphaCheck
items.summary: Stocks declined on Monday as the semiconductor sector came under pressure.
